prompts.prompt: A mountain of crispy tortilla chips loaded with melted, gooey yellow cheddar cheese, bright green jalapeño slices, thick dollops of white sour cream, and fresh pico de gallo. Dark background, cinematic food lighting.
Towering slice of New York cheesecake. A glossy, vibrant red strawberry glaze is dripping down the thick graham cracker crust, topped with fresh dewy berries. Bright, airy bakery lighting, 8k.

Plump shrimp sizzling in a heavy cast-iron pan. Bathed in foaming, golden garlic butter sauce, flecked with chopped green parsley. Charred lemon wedges on the side, thick steam rising, hyper-detailed.

A crispy, golden-brown fried chicken sandwich. Spicy orange mayo is oozing over the edges, thick crinkle-cut pickles, shiny buttered bun. Dark rustic background, shallow depth of field, hyper-detailed crust texture.

A deep bowl of Vietnamese beef pho. The broth is crystal clear but rich in color. Thin slices of rare beef are turning brown as they cook in the hot liquid. Fresh Thai basil, lime wedges, dynamic action shot with steam.

A slice of warm, rustic apple pie. Golden, flaky, sugar-crusted lattice top, bubbling thick cinnamon-spiced apple syrup spilling out. A melting scoop of vanilla ice cream on top, steam rising, cozy lighting.

A towering stack of fluffy buttermilk pancakes. Thick, amber maple syrup is caught mid-pour, dripping sensuously down the sides. A square of golden butter melting on top, fresh blueberries scattered around. Morning sunlight.
Dynamic shot of a sizzling fajita platter. Strips of charred skirt steak, brightly colored steaming bell peppers and onions in a cast-iron skillet. Thick steam billowing up, dark background.
Fresh raw oysters on the half shell resting on crushed ice. Glistening with fresh, briny seawater and droplets of lemon juice. Elegant, dark cinematic aesthetic, hyper-detailed macro photography.

A steaming bowl of tonkotsu ramen. The broth is rich, opaque, and creamy. Topped with thick slices of chashu pork showing glistening fat, a soft-boiled marinated egg with a jammy yolk, nori, and bright green scallions.

An epic cheese pull as a slice of pepperoni pizza is lifted from the pie. Crispy pepperoni cups with slightly charred edges holding small pools of savory orange oil. Dark background, cinematic lighting.

A gourmet grilled cheese sandwich being pulled apart in half. Gooey, stringy mozzarella and sharp cheddar stretching between the halves, golden pan-fried buttery crust. Steaming hot, cozy lighting, 8k.

Thick slice of artisanal sourdough toast smeared with chunky, vibrant green mashed avocado. Topped with red chili flakes, microgreens, and a soft-boiled egg cut in half with a glossy, jammy yolk. Macro lens.

Crispy, golden french fries spilling out of a rustic paper cone. Glistening with a light coat of oil, coarse sea salt flakes clearly visible. A small ramekin of thick, rich red ketchup. Bright lighting, ultra-realistic.
A warm, giant cinnamon roll straight from the oven. Thick, white cream cheese icing is melting and pooling into the spiraled crevices. Steaming hot, cozy morning sunlight streaming from the side.

Crispy Korean fried chicken wings piled on a plate. They are completely coated in a thick, sticky, bright red gochujang glaze. Sprinkled with toasted white sesame seeds, glistening under bright, appetizing lights.

A warm chocolate lava cake freshly broken open. Thick, dark, rich chocolate ganache oozing slowly onto a white plate. A perfect scoop of melting vanilla bean ice cream next to it, fine powdered sugar dusting.

Creamy, authentic spaghetti carbonara. A bright yellow, jammy egg yolk dripping perfectly over hot noodles, crispy chunks of fatty guanciale, generous pecorino romano dusting. Warm Italian restaurant lighting.
Slow-roasted BBQ brisket with a thick, dark pepper bark and a prominent pink smoke ring. Glistening meat juices pooling on a wooden cutting board, rustic lighting, ultra-realistic textures.

Jumbo pan-seared scallops with a perfect golden-brown crust. Sitting on a bed of creamy yellow sweet corn puree, garnished with micro-cilantro and glistening drops of melted brown butter. Elegant, moody lighting.
A freshly fried corn dog on a wooden stick. The golden-brown cornmeal batter is perfectly crispy. A thick, glossy zig-zag of bright yellow mustard runs down the length. Steaming hot, 8k resolution.

Ultra-realistic macro shot of a double cheeseburger. Juicy, sizzling smashed beef patties, dripping bright yellow melted cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, resting on a toasted buttery brioche bun. Cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, food photography.

Twirled spaghetti pasta piled high, smothered in a rich, chunky, glossy meat ragu. A heavy dusting of freshly grated parmesan cheese falling like snow, fresh parsley garnish. Steaming hot, ultra-realistic.

A bowl of Thai tom yum soup. The broth is a vibrant, spicy red-orange with floating pools of chili oil. Plump pink shrimp, stalks of lemongrass, and fresh cilantro. Steam billowing up, dark moody lighting.
A rack of sticky BBQ pork ribs, glossy and caramelized. Garnished with white sesame seeds and fresh chopped green onions. Steaming hot, macro lens, mouth-watering food magazine photography.

A thick, crispy Belgian waffle. The deep square pockets are filled with pools of melted butter and warm syrup. A light dusting of powdered sugar, with a side of sizzling, rippled bacon. Ultra-realistic food photography.

A massive lobster tail split down the middle, bursting with tender, steaming white meat. Dripping with golden clarified butter, a light dusting of smoked paprika. Bright, clean, appetizing lighting, 8k.

Layered tiramisu dessert in a glass dish. Dusted heavily with rich, dark cocoa powder, soft peaks of mascarpone cream, espresso-soaked ladyfingers visible through the glass. Macro photography, elegant lighting.

Authentic Mexican street tacos on soft, warm corn tortillas. Juicy, reddish-orange al pastor meat with charred edges, fresh diced white onions, cilantro, and a glossy drizzle of bright green tomatillo salsa.

Extreme close-up of a BLT. Thick-cut, sizzling crispy bacon with glistening fat, bright red juicy heirloom tomatoes, crisp iceberg lettuce, mayonnaise spreading on toasted golden sourdough. Sharp focus, high contrast.

Slices of crispy Peking duck. The skin is a glossy, lacquered, caramelized mahogany color, attached to steaming, tender meat. Served alongside thin white pancakes and a dollop of thick, dark hoisin sauce. 8k.
Plump, pillowy potato gnocchi coated in a vibrant green, oily basil pesto sauce. Toasted golden pine nuts and delicate shavings of parmesan cheese. Rustic wooden table background, hyper-detailed.

Macro shot of a classic glazed yeast donut. The vanilla glaze is shiny and translucent, reflecting the light. A single bite taken out reveals a soft, airy, fluffy interior. Pastel background, highly detailed.
Thick slices of brioche French toast. A caramelized, golden-brown crispy crust, topped with fresh, dewy raspberries and a thick drizzle of golden honey. Bright, natural morning lighting.

A traditional crock of French onion soup. A thick, heavy layer of gruyere cheese is deeply browned, bubbling, and overflowing the sides of the bowl. Rich, dark, steaming beef broth visible beneath the cheese crust.
Herb-crusted roasted lamb chops, perfectly pink inside, dripping with a rich, glossy brown demi-glace. Served on an elegant white plate, soft candlelit restaurant background, hyper-detailed.

Crispy, golden-fried Indian samosas with a blistered, flaky crust. One is broken open in the center, revealing steaming, heavily spiced potatoes and green peas. A glossy drizzle of mint-cilantro chutney.

Luxurious fettuccine alfredo. A thick, glossy, creamy white cheese sauce perfectly coating the wide noodles. Coarse cracked black pepper, steam rising gently, shallow depth of field, elegant food styling.

Medium-rare ribeye steak freshly sliced open, revealing a glistening pink center and a crusty, dark char. Melting garlic-herb compound butter dripping over the top, resting on a dark slate board. Sprig of fresh rosemary, cinematic lighting.

Ultra-realistic macro shot of fresh nigiri sushi. Glossy, translucent slices of raw salmon and bright red tuna over perfectly formed, slightly sticky rice. A dab of bright green wasabi, high-end restaurant lighting.

Authentic Neapolitan pizza hot out of a wood-fired oven. Blistered, charred leopard-spotted crust, pools of bubbling fresh mozzarella, bright red glossy San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh green basil leaves.
A gourmet hot dog in a soft, steamed bun. Loaded to the brim with deeply caramelized sweet onions, bright green sweet relish, and dripping spicy brown mustard. Macro shot, highly detailed textures.

A thick square of baked lasagna. Beautiful layers of white ricotta, savory ground beef, and pasta. Crispy, browned, bubbling cheese on the top edges, rich red tomato sauce pooling on the plate. Mouth-watering macro shot.

Har gow (shrimp dumplings) sitting in a traditional bamboo steamer. The wrappers are slightly translucent, glossy, and pleated, showing the pink plump shrimp filling inside. Thick steam rolling out, macro photography.

Mouth-watering pulled pork sandwich. Rich, sticky, mahogany BBQ sauce dripping down the sides, topped with creamy crisp coleslaw on a soft potato bun. Dramatic side lighting highlighting the glossy sauce, steam rising.
A massive breakfast burrito sliced in half. Steaming hot, fluffy scrambled eggs, melted sharp cheddar cheese stretching, crispy golden hash browns, and spicy red chorizo. Dark rustic background.
Charred cob of corn held by a hand. Thickly coated in creamy mayonnaise, generously crumbled white cotija cheese, and a vibrant red dusting of chili powder. Vibrant, lively background.

Perfectly poached egg on top of Canadian bacon and a toasted English muffin. The egg is sliced open, and golden, runny yolk is spilling out, mixing with a rich, glossy, buttery hollandaise sauce. 8k resolution.
Crispy, golden-battered fried calamari rings piled high. A side of thick, creamy tartar sauce with herbs, and a freshly squeezed lemon half with juice droplets. Sharp focus, mouth-watering textures.

A perfect stack of French macarons in vibrant pastel colors. Glossy chocolate ganache and fruit jam fillings peeking out. Soft, airy shell textures with a delicate "foot," bright and airy lighting, 8k resolution.
